jobs.description:
About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people. 

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization. 

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:
	
• Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.	
• Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.	
• Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.	
• Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.	
• Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.	
• Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:
	
• Experience in a production environment.	
• Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.	
• Ability to work with a computer.	
• Good command of English or Dutch.	
• Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.	
• Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.	
• No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).	
• Physical work does not deter you.	
• Basic technical knowledge.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.
Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:
	
• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.	
• Risk analysis.	
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:
	
• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.	
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.	
• Commitment and practical approach to work.	
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.	
• Curiosity and passion for technology.	
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.	
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.	
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.	
• Teamwork and communication skills.	
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.	
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.

Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:
	
• Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).	
• Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.	
• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:
	
• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines	
• Processing and assembling wooden components	
• Performing quality checks on finished products	
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met	
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:
	
• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines	
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)	
• Is not afraid of physical work	
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)	
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:
Are you seeking a new challenge where you can utilize your physical strength and precision? Our client, a renowned company in pallet production, is looking for a Robot Operator for Pallet Production.

As a Robot Operator for Pallet Production, you will be responsible for operating the production robot. Your role includes preparing the workstation: arranging planks and components on the worktable, which are then automatically assembled by the robot. The job requires physical effort, is repetitive in nature, and takes place in a noisy environment. Therefore, we are looking for someone who is up for the challenge.

Your tasks include:
	
• Preparing and placing planks and components on the worktable.	
• Operating and monitoring the production robot.	
• Ensuring a safe and efficient work environment.	
• Collaborating with the team to ensure smooth production processes.

Profile Description
What are we looking for?

We are seeking an energetic and physically strong individual who meets the following requirements:
	
• You are physically fit and comfortable with repetitive tasks.	
• You are flexible: until September, you will work in a day shift, and afterward in a two-shift system (morning and afternoon shifts).	
• You can communicate in Dutch or English to collaborate effectively with the team.	
• You work accurately and have attention to detail.	
• You have prior experience in a production environment.

Our client is looking for a highly organised Customer Experience Operations Administrator to support the smooth running of its European operations. Acting as a key administrative link between Customer Care, Finance, Supply Chain, and Warehouse teams, this role offers a broad scope of responsibilities in a dynamic international environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation operating within a highly regulated and innovative industry. From its European hub in Brussels, the company supports customers across multiple European markets, delivering high-quality solutions and services while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, collaboration, and operational excellence.

 

Description

Invoicing & Financial Administration

• Prepare, verify, and process invoices for customer service activities across European markets.
• Review work orders, service reports, and supporting documentation prior to invoicing.
• Follow up on missing, incomplete, or inaccurate information.
• Collaborate closely with Finance to ensure accurate and timely billing.

Administrative Support

• Maintain and update administrative records and documentation.
• Ensure data accuracy within ERP and CRM systems.
• Provide administrative support to Customer Experience and Customer Care teams.
• Prepare, monitor, and manage a variety of operational documents and reports.

Supply Chain & Warehouse Support

• Provide administrative back-up for spare parts order processing.
• Support logistics and warehouse administration activities.
• Assist with shipment documentation and transportation-related paperwork.
• Act as a flexible support resource during peak periods or colleague absences.

International Coordination

• Communicate regularly with customers and colleagues across Europe.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between various departments and countries.

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in an administrative, customer service, or commercial support role.
• Experience with invoicing or billing processes is a strong advantage.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Customer-oriented mindset and effective communication skills.
• Ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
• Flexible, proactive, and supportive team player.
• Capable of working independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
• Experience with ERP systems is an advantage; SAP knowledge is considered a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and French
• Knowledge of German is highly desirable
• Good level of English

You'll be part of a renewable energy consultancy with global reach, focused on creating sustainable solutions for tomorrow. The culture of the company is more informal but in a professional way, open and supportive, offering you both professional growth and the chance to contribute to meaningful projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Maintain and update internal systems and databases (e.g. project tracking, HR and finance tools)
• Coordinate schedules and resources for internal programmes and training sessions
• Assist with reporting, data checks and preparing presentations for management
• Support HR processes such as onboarding administration and training follow-up
• Handle administrative follow-up for suppliers and internal approvals
• Ensure accurate documentation, filing and archiving (digital and hard copy)
• Take on ad hoc administrative tasks that keep the office and operations running smoothly

• 2+ years of experience in administration, coordination or office support
• Organised, detail-oriented and flexible in handling different priorities
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• A strong communicator in English, Dutch (and French)
• Proactive, service-minded and a natural team player
• Diploma in administration, business or similar is a plus but not required

Our client is a recognised player in real estate advisory, specialising in supporting investors and corporates with strategic property transactions. With a solid reputation and deep market expertise, the company combines local market knowledge with a forward-looking investment approach, delivering tailored solutions across multiple asset classes.

Jobomschrijving

• Identify and originate new investment opportunities in the real estate market
• Build and manage a portfolio of investors and key stakeholders
• Develop financial models and investment cases for complex transactions
• Conduct market research, trend analysis, and due diligence
• Advise clients on transaction structuring and investment strategies
• Prepare high-quality presentations and investment memoranda
• Collaborate with internal teams to execute deals end-to-end
• Contribute to the growth and positioning of the business unit

• Relevant experience in finance, banking, real estate or investment advisory (3 to 8 years)
• Strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities
• Commercial mindset with a track record of business development or deal-making
• Excellent communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build relationships with senior-level stakeholders
• Proactive, ambitious, and results-driven personality
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Bilingual Dutch and French, English is an asset

• Partner with sales teams to structure financing solutions for strategic deals.
• Advise clients on funding options, business cases and investment projects.
• Build relationships with banks, insurers and other financial partners.
• Develop innovative financial products that support business growth.
• Assess financial risks and provide recommendations to management.

• Drive best practices, improve processes and support commercial excellence.

The successful candidate matches the following criteria:

• Master Degree in Finance/ Banking
• Fluent in French and English, Dutch is an asset
• 3-5 years experience 
• Good communication skills, commercial flair
• Analytical approach, experience in risk analysis is a plus
• Experience in Big 4 or consulting can be a great asset

Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.Customer Service Excellence

• Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
• Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
• Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
• Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
• Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.

Compliance & Documentation

• Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
• Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
• Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
• Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
• Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).

Our client is an FMCG player active in household products and based in Walloon Brabant.

They are looking for a sales support in their KAM team to support the Sales Manager and the sales team for the Retailers Lidl & Aldi.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support German/English your responsibilities are:

• You will coordinate client projects and queries
• You will support the sales team in offers and tenders
• You will support in the launch of commercial actions
• You will do administrative follow up on commercial files
• You will collect, analyze and consolidate commercial information for future purposes
• You will do the overall support of the Key Account Managers in charge of Aldi and Lidl

A successful Sales Support German/English should have:

• Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken. French is a plus
• Experience in a customer service or sales support role in the FMCG sector
• Experience with Lidl or Aldi is a big advantage
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Proficiency with standard office software and CRM tools
• Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.
As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.

You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.
You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.

Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

Are you commercially minded and do you enjoy working with customers? Are you looking for a job that is never the same and where you get opportunities to grow?

Then maybe you are our new CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE!

For our client, the largest private rail freight operator in Europe, we are looking for a customer care representative to join the Freight Force.

As a customer care representative you will: Process owner for the booking & check-in process
  
• You accept bookings on customer request  
• You make bookings yourself of containers and wagons on trains and you send the booking instructions and agreements to Order Management  
• You inform and make the customer acquainted with the Customer Portal so that he is able to makes his own bookings. You assist the customer in every step of the booking process.  
• You manage changes of the original booking  
• You check if basic commercial data is known and is supported via the Customer Portal. If no, you inform and request assistance from Inside Sales to amend lacking commercial information  
• You rectify the missing and/or wrong contract number for import orders to ensure quick O2C  
• You make sure that all booking details are correct and that there are no anomalies that can slow down the order-to-cash process  
• You prepare template of the railway bill/consignment note.  
• You make the consignment note (as a paid service or if in high special need for assistance)
Commercial tasks
  
• You are able to maximize the fill rate of each train by finding the extra box/wagon and by consulting the customer on a professional and commercial way (based on parameters of Commercial Margin Management)  
• You manage the customer relation daily and (pro-) actively to create a lock-in opportunity and retain Customer satisfaction.  
• You build a customer relationship through high standard service delivery and execution.  
• You highten awareness and inform the client of successful products  
• You inform and share knowledge with other stake-holders within the company to inform and update on this new transport relation
Customer behavior
  
• You discuss and try to understand the booking behaviors and needs of the Customer via commercial discussions based on KPI’s (in relation to SLA)  
• You sharing info about the customer behavior with commercial stake-holders (commercial Margin Management/Key accountmanagers/Inside Sales/...)
Communication
  
• You are pro-actively by thinking with the customer, assessing and acting before possible incidents.  
• You assure the tracking & tracing (within office hours) via Customer Portal and other ways (digitalization is key and our future aim)  
• You receive and assist the Customer with his complaint within our organisation and stakeholders

Who are we looking for?

As a Customer Service Representative, you are primarily focused on customer service. You have a commercial mentality and are able to communicate with the customer in a professional way.
  
• You have a bachelor degree or equivalent through experience;  
• You have strong communication skills and are able to understand and translate the customers needs;  
• You speak English fluently. A good knowledge of French and Dutch is required. Knowledge of German or another language is a plus;  
• You have experience in managing an account and you are able to work on customer relations and loyalty;  
• You have knowledge of the various Microsoft Office programs and are quick to learn proprietary systems;  
• You are organized, detail-oriented and have the drive to work in a commercial and professional manner;  
• You have the necessary persuasiveness and commercial flair, are proactive and can work alone as well as in a team;  
• You are a multitasker and are someone who values efficiency;  
• You can cope with a changing environment.

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
 

 
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations
 
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport
 
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site
 
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner 

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
 

 
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally
 
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required
 
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)
 
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions
